title: AGM: Achievement-Grounded Memory for Closed-Loop Agents with Frozen VLA Policies
abstract: arXiv:2608.29537v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policies offer broad manipulation skills but execute open-loop action chunks without tracking task progress, so the agent cannot reliably decide whether to continue, retry, or terminate. External memory is a natural remedy, yet it can be harmful when attempted actions are treated as completed progress, turning local execution errors into persistent task-state errors. We propose Achievement-Grounded Memory (AGM), a lightweight closed-loop framework for frozen VLA policies that represents a task as a subgoal sequence with a progress pointer and advances this memory only after the current subgoal is verified by physical evidence. Proprioceptive interaction cues decide when to verify, while coherent point tracking and language-conditioned cross-view comparison, sourced from frozen foundation models through a single 2.43M-parameter verification head, decide what was achieved. AGM thereby converts open-loo

translated_title: AGM：面向冻结VLA策略闭环智能体的成就锚定记忆
translated_abstract: 冻结的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略具备广泛的操作技能，但以开环方式执行动作块且不跟踪任务进度，因此智能体无法可靠地决定是继续、重试还是终止。外部记忆是一种自然的补救手段，然而当尝试过的动作被误当作已完成的进度时，外部记忆反而可能有害，将局部执行错误转化为持久的任务状态错误。我们提出了成就锚定记忆（AGM），这是一个面向冻结VLA策略的轻量级闭环框架，它将任务表示为带有进度指针的子目标序列，并且只有在当前子目标通过物理证据验证后才会推进该记忆。本体感觉交互线索决定何时进行验证，而连贯点跟踪与语言条件下的跨视角比较则决定究竟完成了什么，这两者均来源于冻结的基础模型，仅通过一个2.43M参数的验证头实现。由此，AGM将开环执行转化为闭环执行。
tldr: 提出成就锚定记忆（AGM）这一轻量级闭环框架，仅通过物理证据验证子目标完成情况才推进任务进度记忆，使冻结的VLA策略能够可靠地决定继续、重试或终止操作。
en_tdlr: AGM is a lightweight closed-loop framework that advances task progress memory only when subgoals are verified by physical evidence, enabling frozen VLA policies to reliably decide whether to continue, retry, or terminate.
